title: Spike scaffolding: benchmark matrix, persona payloads, canary tasks and gates (Story 1.7)
summary: Create ten small disposable, secret-free files in a throwaway target repository for an evidence-only benchmark spike: a verbatim matrix YAML, a full persona payload file copied byte-exact from two provisioned inputs, a compact role contract under 600 bytes, three short canary task bodies, three deterministic bash gates, and a ten-line README. Fully specified, relative paths only, no production code, no network. A self-check gate declared before dispatch verifies shape, exactness and gate non-vacuity.
